name: SocketGateway wrapped-token swap route arbitrary call
summary: SocketGateway route 406, WrappedTokenSwapperImpl, made the gateway call fromToken with caller-supplied swapExtraData after pulling only the caller's own amount. With amount 0 and an ERC-20 as fromToken, attackers had the gateway execute transferFrom(victim, attacker, amount) on tokens users had approved to the gateway, draining those approvals.
notes: Reset: route 406 was registered by addRoute three days before the exploit; the gateway proxy itself was not upgraded. Same-impl routes added on OP, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base and Avalanche saw only wrap/unwrap use before they were disabled.

Campaign from every zero-amount WrappedTokenSwapperImpl SocketSwapTokens event before the route was disabled: the attacker's second drain, a copycat that took 840 MATIC, and a c0ffeebabe front-run of 870 USDC. Later returns by the attacker are not netted.
